purpose: Candidate product-testing defaults for low-risk educational practice families. These are not treatment doses, medical advice, or final-day prescriptions.
rules: Every practice is optional and has a no-practice alternative.
Minimum is a valid completion; extended is never the morally preferred choice.
Stop signals override streaks, points, plans, and curriculum progression.
Symptoms, disability, medication, trauma, violence, and urgent risk route to appropriate human support rather than personalization by Motazen.
All wording and ranges require Egyptian clinical, behavioral, accessibility, and user review before production use.

practiceFamilies.scope: Briefly notice and name an emotion, body cue, or thought without diagnosing it.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Choose one broad word or select 'غير واضح'.
practiceFamilies.standard: Notice for up to 60 seconds and record one word plus context if desired.
practiceFamilies.extended: Compare two moments only when this remains neutral and useful.
alternatives: skip and choose a practical action

practiceFamilies.scope: Use a present external sensory detail as an optional grounding anchor.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Notice one visible object or one contact point.
practiceFamilies.standard: Notice three neutral external details for up to 60 seconds.
practiceFamilies.extended: Walk slowly through several neutral details only if safe and accessible.

practiceFamilies.scope: Invite comfortable unforced breathing only as one optional calming route.
practiceFamilies.minimum: One comfortable exhale without counting or breath holding.
practiceFamilies.standard: Several comfortable breaths for no more than one minute.
practiceFamilies.extended: Not enabled until clinical review defines safe boundaries.
alternatives: seek medical help for urgent symptoms

practiceFamilies.scope: Record one thought as a mental event and identify what is known, unknown, or actionable.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Write or select one short phrase.
practiceFamilies.standard: Add one fact and one uncertainty, then stop.
practiceFamilies.extended: Review one alternative explanation only if it reduces confusion rather than fuels rumination.

practiceFamilies.scope: Clarify options, constraints, stakeholders, uncertainty, and a reversible next step.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Name the decision and one option, including 'delay safely'.
practiceFamilies.standard: Compare up to three options on two relevant criteria.
practiceFamilies.extended: Seek missing information or a human perspective before revisiting.
stopSignals: legal or medical stakes beyond competence

practiceFamilies.scope: Try one low-cost action that remains within current capacity and control.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Define an action under two minutes or choose rest/support instead.
practiceFamilies.standard: Try once and record only whether it was possible and useful.
practiceFamilies.extended: Repeat for a short test window without a streak obligation.

practiceFamilies.scope: Protect one brief interval for one chosen task without diagnosing attention difficulty.
practiceFamilies.minimum: One minute or one task step.
practiceFamilies.standard: Five to fifteen minutes with a visible end.
practiceFamilies.extended: A personally tested interval with breaks; no universal target.
alternatives: professional ADHD assessment when persistent impairment warrants it

practiceFamilies.scope: Test one reversible environment change rather than impose abstinence or a fixed screen limit.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Silence one nonessential alert for one chosen interval.
practiceFamilies.standard: Move one distracting shortcut or place the device within safe reach but outside direct view.
practiceFamilies.extended: Run a short personal comparison and restore settings if worse.

practiceFamilies.scope: Notice one sleep-related pattern without prescribing a universal duration or treating insomnia.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Record whether rest felt insufficient, sufficient, or unclear.
practiceFamilies.standard: Notice one factor such as timing, caffeine, light, pain, shift work, or caregiving.
practiceFamilies.extended: Discuss persistent or severe difficulty with an appropriate health professional rather than intensify tracking.

practiceFamilies.scope: Offer a small comfortable movement option adapted to ability, health, setting, and safety.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Change position or move one comfortable body part if safe.
practiceFamilies.standard: A few minutes of personally comfortable movement.
practiceFamilies.extended: Follow individualized professional guidance when health conditions or disability require it.
alternatives: seek urgent medical care for urgent symptoms

practiceFamilies.scope: Draft a concise observation, need, request, or listening response without requiring confrontation.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Write privately and do not send.
practiceFamilies.standard: Rehearse with a safe person or choose a low-stakes situation.
practiceFamilies.extended: Use in a real conversation only when consent, privacy, and safety are adequate.

practiceFamilies.scope: Clarify a personal limit and safe options without instructing the user to test another person.
practiceFamilies.standard: List one safe action under the user's control.
practiceFamilies.extended: Seek legal, clinical, workplace, or safeguarding advice when consequences are significant.
alternatives: safety planning with a qualified human

practiceFamilies.scope: Identify possible human, professional, community, or practical support without assuming family safety or service availability.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Name one possible category of support or mark 'لا يوجد الآن'.
practiceFamilies.standard: Identify one person/service, purpose, access barrier, and backup.
practiceFamilies.extended: Verify current access directly before relying on a service.
alternatives: nearest emergency department for urgent danger after professional wording review

practiceFamilies.scope: Use a brief optional note to support recall or planning, not mandatory disclosure or trauma processing.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Select one option without free text.
practiceFamilies.standard: Write one or two sentences and stop.
practiceFamilies.extended: Review later only if storage is private and review is useful.

practiceFamilies.scope: Review a bounded correctable error using event, feedback, correction, and next test while excluding loss, abuse, injustice, and irreversible harm.
practiceFamilies.minimum: Name one new piece of information or choose not to review.
practiceFamilies.standard: Record what happened, one correction, and one safe retry.
practiceFamilies.extended: Seek qualified feedback for consequential domains before retrying.
